digest.component_or_area: ADR 0098 — Operation-Scoped Configuration and Provider Composition
propositions: ADR 0098 must document the approved decision that Rebar composes immutable non-secret operation configuration separately from provider-auth and runtime bindings at application boundaries.
All external dependency and OSS behavior claims in ADR 0098 must cite specific primary-source research or maintained Rebar probes from the completed RP-04 research artifacts.

ADR 0098 must record decisions on operation snapshot precedence, CLI/MCP/Python/service composition ownership, provider-native auth injection, subprocess environment rules, static restart/redeploy rotation, and fail-closed authentication without implementing RP-04 production code.

ADR 0098 must clarify relationships to ADRs 0008, 0014, 0041, 0046, 0049, 0050, 0059, and 0083 while narrowing ADR 0049 only at the per-job retrieval/composition seam and preserving all unaffected decisions.

The generated ADR artifacts (docs/adr/0098-operation-scoped-config-and-provider-composition.md, docs/adr/README.md, .numbers/0098) must pass deterministic ADR-number, index, and documentation checks with no placeholder sections or merge-conflict markers.

ADR 0098 must complete draft critique identifying uncited claims, inconsistencies, missing constraints, and ADR conflicts before maintainer authorization and merge, with the ADR status set to Accepted only after explicit approval.
